description: Finalize an S3-compatible multipart upload in B2 by assembling uploaded parts. Use only after s3_create_multipart_upload and s3_get_presigned_upload_part_url (or s3_upload_part_copy) have produced every required part; use s3_list_parts to verify uploaded parts before retrying. Requires writeFiles. Completion is idempotent only when B2 already committed the exact same part list; if the response is lost, reconcile with s3_head_object or s3_list_object_versions before retrying.

bucket.description: Destination bucket name used to create the multipart upload.

key.description: Destination object key used to create the multipart upload.

parts.description: Complete ordered part manifest. Include every part in ascending partNumber order (part numbers are 1-10000); missing or stale ETags fail the completion call.

etag.description: The ETag from this part's direct PUT response (the s3_get_presigned_upload_part_url flow).

partNumber.description: Provider-valid multipart part number from 1-10000 for this ETag; provide each uploaded part once.

name: s3_complete_multipart_upload
